results.title: Tamil Thai Vazhthu to be sung first at Tamil Nadu events; CM Vijay calls it state right, Kamal Haasan welcomes move
results.description: TAMIL NADU, (India): The Tamil Nadu Assembly has unanimously passed a resolution making Tamil Thai Vazhthu the first song to be sung at government events, educational institutions and other public functions across the state.

results.title: Military airstrikes on civilians rose before Myanmar vote, UN report finds
results.description: Myanmar's military intensified air attacks on civilians before the disputed 2025/26 election, UN report finds
